The KIOTI NS4710MB Series: Power, Precision, and Practical Performance.

The KIOTI NS4710MB Manual ROPS is a utility-class tractor built to handle demanding jobs while offering comfort, strength, and reliability. It features a robust 45.3-horsepower KIOTI 3-cylinder turbocharged diesel engine and a 12F/12R manual shuttle transmission for smooth, efficient operation in the field or around the property. Designed for those who want open-station control with manual engagement, the foldable ROPS system enhances safety while maintaining flexibility. Ideal for loader work, hauling, mowing, and land management, the NS4710MB is built to deliver long-lasting value and capability.

Features May Include:

  • Engine: 45.3 hp, 3-cylinder KIOTI turbo diesel, Tier 4 compliant

  • Transmission: 12F / 12R Synchro Shuttle for reliable gear selection

  • Drive: 4WD with manual engagement

  • Power Steering: Hydraulic power steering for precise handling

  • PTO: Independent rear PTO with approx. 37.6 hp

  • Hydraulics: 16.7 GPM total flow with Category I 3-point hitch, lifting approx. 2,716 lbs

  • Brakes: Wet disc brakes for consistent stopping performance

  • ROPS: Foldable manual rollover protective structure

  • Ground Clearance: 13.4 in.

  • Wheelbase: 73.8 in. (1,875 mm)

  • Turning Radius: 9.5 ft. (2.9 m) with brakes

  • Operating Weight: Approx. 3,417 lbs (without loader)
